name: ~Ikusei Mahjong~ Mahjong Yuugi
source:
Main character returns to home town and joins mahjong school club where his old friend presides. They start preparing for the national mahjong tournament. 

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-september-2001-eve-fatal.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公回到故乡，加入由老朋友担任部长的麻将社。众人开始为全国麻将大赛作准备。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-september-2001-eve-fatal.html]vndbreview[/url]]
